notes: Run with /skill-creator in a fresh session. Before running eval id 0, plant the bug (see evals/PLANT-A-BUG.md) so the skill exercises the full diagnose -> RED-test -> fix loop. Restore the repo (git checkout) between every with-skill and baseline run. Run the subagents serially, never in parallel — capability-shakedown mutates the working tree.

evals.prompt: Something's off with `codegenie gather` — when I run it against a Node app that has a Dockerfile, the entrypoint section of repo-context.yaml comes back empty. Exercise the gather capability against a sample app, figure out the root cause, and fix it.
evals.expected_output: Triggers capability-shakedown. Explores the project, runs `codegenie gather` against a sample app with a Dockerfile, diagnoses the empty entrypoint as a codebase no-op bug (the dockerfile probe does not publish raw/dockerfile.json so the entrypoint consumer reads nothing), does a test-gap analysis, writes a test that fails on the bug first, fixes the producer, verifies `make check` is green, sweeps affected docs, and writes a report under docs/_shakedowns/.

assertions.text: Root-caused the empty entrypoint to the dockerfile probe not publishing its raw/dockerfile.json sidecar (a codebase no-op bug), not to a sample-app or environment cause
Wrote or identified a test and observed it FAIL on the unfixed code before applying the fix (RED-first discipline)
Applied a code fix that makes the entrypoint slice populate, and `make check` passes green afterward
Performed an explicit test-gap analysis explaining why the existing suite missed the bug
Wrote a shakedown report under docs/_shakedowns/ with a findings table and root-cause classes
Did not push to git and did not commit without an explicit --commit flag

evals.prompt: Exercise `codegenie vuln-index refresh` end to end against a sample app and tell me whether it actually works. If something is missing or broken, diagnose the root cause — is it our code, the environment, or the sample app — and fix it.
evals.expected_output: Triggers capability-shakedown. Derives the vuln-index refresh command and its expected output (a populated sqlite vuln-index), runs it, and classifies any gap into a root-cause bucket with evidence. Either fixes a real finding through the appropriate route or reports a clean run explicitly (not a silent pass).

assertions.text: Derived the correct `codegenie vuln-index refresh` invocation and stated what a correct run should produce before running it
Classified every finding into exactly one root-cause bucket (codebase-bug / environment / sample-app / by-design) with evidence
If the run was clean, said so explicitly with how to verify — did not declare a silent pass
Wrote a shakedown report under docs/_shakedowns/
